newsitem.title: USA: Crown says NLRB dismisses labor practice charges.
newsitem.headline: Crown says NLRB dismisses labor practice charges.

text.p: Crown Central Petroleum said on Monday that the National Labor Relations Board for the Dallas/Fort Worth region had dismissed charges of unfair labor practices filed against the company by the Oil, Chemical and Atomic Workers International Union.

The charges, stemming from a lockout that began in February last year and is ongoing, included issues of bargaining in good faith, subcontracting bargaining unit work, the union's handbilling at company retail locations, and unit members' request for 401(k) plan withdrawals, Crown said.
"We are pleased that the NLRB has dismissed the charges and refused to issue a complaint," said Crown chairman Henry Rosenberg.
The decision to dismiss charges may be appealed to the NLRB general counsel, the company added.
